title: ISS-164 test covers splitAdvisory() only; the exit-code wiring in main() is unasserted and a mutant survives
evidence: Mutation on scripts/tracker-audit.mjs: `process.exit(findings.length === 0 ? 0 : 1)` -> `process.exit(findings.length + advisory.length === 0 ? 0 : 1)` (advisory findings gate again). Result: tracker-audit.test.mjs + ledger-union.test.mjs 46 pass, 2 fail, the same 2 failures as base; no test noticed. Disabling or inverting splitAdvisory itself IS caught (2/2).
reproduction: Apply the one-line mutant above, run node --test scripts/lib/tracker-audit.test.mjs scripts/lib/ledger-union.test.mjs; restore.
fix_direction: Add a CLI-level test: a temp root with only a qa/verdicts/ bare-ref finding must exit 0 with an advisory line.
